offers.name: FAIS Digital Finance Employee Empowerment Package
offers.audience: South African FSPs, banks, insurers, brokerages, advisers, compliance teams, key individuals, representatives and crypto-asset businesses
outcomes: Practical digital-finance literacy across regulated teams
Crypto-asset, payment, fraud and cyber-risk awareness
Role-specific learning for representatives, key individuals, compliance, operations and leadership
Better employee confidence when customers raise digital-asset and modern-payment questions
Optional alignment mapping to FAISReady exam-readiness pathways without replacing regulatory requirements
regulatory_boundary: This package is employee empowerment and professional development, not a substitute for RE examinations, recognised qualifications, Class of Business training, product-specific training or any other applicable Fit and Proper requirement.
It must not be marketed as approved CPD unless the relevant CPD recognition/approval has been obtained for the specific activity.
For crypto-asset FSPs, course mapping may support internal competence development, but statutory requirements remain the responsibility of the FSP, key individual and representative.

cross_sell.relationship: Optional companion for regulatory-exam preparation and workforce-readiness; the two products remain independently deployable.

pricing.note: Private academy setup, bespoke integrations and custom localisation may be scoped separately.

automation.normal_path: Automated onboarding decision, baseline routing, role-based learning, progress/remediation, completion eligibility, pseudonymous state persistence, action outbox and institution-level reporting.
automation.governance: Human review is retained for regulatory, identity, security, appeals, regulated-advice, policy-conflict and payment-dispute exceptions.
automation.production_boundary: Pseudonymous learner state/reporting is built. Protected identity, roster import, notification, certificate and payment-entitlement adapters still require connection before claiming complete zero-touch production administration.

configuration.contract_note: Institutional pricing is quote-based and requires a signed commercial scope. Consumer iKhokha checkout is not used for institutional contracting.
configuration.accreditation_note: Institutional delivery does not create a degree or accredited qualification unless separately approved and evidenced.
